description: Row H1 (Django 1.10 + DRF 3.4): author-only article updates and comment deletion, with comments scoped to the article in the URL.
notes: Security task (authorization and ownership). Hidden tests use Django's test runner (the repo's own framework; the repo ships no tests) with DRF's APIClient and JWT tokens from User.token, and check the database after each request, so any enforcement point (view code, a permission class, a queryset filter) passes. On the pinned SHA a non-author's PUT returns 200 and a stranger's comment DELETE returns 204, so the run fails. Environment: the pinned requirements (Django 1.10.5, DRF 3.4.4, PyJWT 1.4.2) need Python <= 3.9, so setup builds a uv-managed CPython 3.8 venv in /deps/venv (first on PATH in the image). Django 1.10.5's admin widgets.py has a generator-with-trailing-comma that is a SyntaxError on Python >= 3.7; setup patches that one line in the installed package (outside the repo) and byte-compiles it, then runs manage.py check so an import problem becomes a skipped run with a reason. The agent sees the same /deps/venv Python. budget_usd is a placeholder sized like a medium task.
